'''Elayne Traemane''' was an [[Andoran]] noblewoman who was the grandmother of Lady [[Ellorien Traemane]].{{ref/book|5|19}}

== Activities ==
Queen [[Morgase Trakand]] named her daughter and heir [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]] in honor of Lady Elayne Traemane.<ref name="comp">''[[The Wheel of Time Companion]]'', Elayne Traemane.</ref> However, despite this honor, Lady Ellorien is disgusted at House Trakand after Morgase orders her flogged when she is held under [[Compulsion]] by [[Rahvin]] as "Lord Gaebril."{{ref/book|5|19}}
